traceability.notes:
docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md defines the foundational ESLint plugin structure. The implementation in src/index.ts, along with the package configuration and extensive Jest tests, satisfies all the story's acceptance criteria and technical requirements:
- Core Functionality: The plugin loads, exposes a rules registry, and exports configs as confirmed by tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts, plus CLI integration tests using ESLint v9 flat config. - Quality Standards: The plugin follows standard ESLint plugin conventions (default export with rules/configs, conventional rule IDs, TypeScript implementation, npm package metadata) and is covered by targeted tests and linting. - Integration with ESLint v9 flat config: Verified both by the root eslint.config.js used in integration tests and by tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts using FlatESLint and the plugin’s configs.recommended/strict. - User Experience: README.md provides clear installation steps, ESLint v9 flat config examples, quick start instructions, and guidance on running tests and validating the plugin, fulfilling the UX and documentation-related criteria for this story. - Error Handling: src/index.ts wraps dynamic rule loading in try/catch, logs failures, and supplies a placeholder rule; tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts verify this behavior at both module and CLI levels. - Documentation & Dev Setup: README.md covers installation, configuration, running tests, and plugin validation, and the project scripts plus TypeScript/Jest setup implement the required testing infrastructure.
Given the passing test suite (including all tests tagged with this story) and the concrete code and documentation evidence, this story is fully implemented.
